shared_elements: frontal upright anthropomorphic figure carved on a monolithic block
head with elaborate/wide headdress or headgear at top
face with prominent eyes, nose and mouth in frontal view
chest and shoulder ornaments including circular discs
low-relief incised decoration covering the body
tall vertical monument standing on a plinth/base
justification: Both present a single frontal standing anthropomorphic figure on a tall stone monolith, ordered top-to-bottom as broad headdress, staring face, chest with circular disc ornaments, a horizontal belt band, and a plain base — a genuinely comparable compositional scheme. The rendering differs sharply, however: A is dense, deeply undercut, intricately detailed relief recorded in fine draughtsmanship, while B is a heavily eroded, blocky, shallow-incised mass with far simpler and coarser forms.
